title: 第21章 返回圣心第22章 幼女胡列娜
slug: 斗罗之张三的逆袭人生
content_zh:
其实这替身纸人，系统是有给详细介绍的，只不过得在系统面板内的“物品图鉴”上寻找。
在得到系统提示后，张三前去查看，发现上面的详细介绍内容是：
【稀有道具·替身纸人】
【背景：初由苗疆巫毒祖师伽蓝开创，后经数十代人改造而成的替身符，“纸人自焚，替人挡灾”。】
【特性：抵抗、生存、消耗品。】
【使用效果：1、立即生成一个纸人替身；2、纸人替身可以为使用者抵挡伤害，并且在纸人完全被破坏前，敌人的优先攻击目标将始终放在纸人上（该效果可被精神力抵抗）；3、在纸人完全破坏前，可令使用者增加移动速度并进入隐形状态（攻击或被攻击后该效果立刻移除）。】
【备注：替身纸人本身不具备任何攻击或闪避能力，不继承使用者任何特殊能力，其身体强度与使用者持平。】
“这可是个保命的好东西，可不能再这样乱用了。”
张三看完介绍内容，算是明白这“替身纸人”有多有用了，这哪里是“替身纸人”，分明是“保命纸人”，说这三个替身纸人就是给自己加了三条命也不为过。
只是现在他已经不小心浪费了一张，顿时心痛不已，赶紧将剩下的两张纸人都装入“一十三楼蔽日天”内，以免再出岔子。
“散！”
而那张纸人所化“张三”，则在张三意念的催动下化作了一阵白烟，很快就消失的无影无踪。
在张三对这一切啧啧称奇之时，张三看了一眼外面的时钟，发现距离自己出发的时间也不多了，就准备前往预定的马车集合点集合。
由于他有储物魂导器，周围的人却都拿着大包小包，两手空空的张三自在得意的爬上马车，并找了个靠里面的位置坐下。
载人马车的后面是一辆长板货车，那货车的车夫叫道：“喂！小子，你有行李吗？放这里来。”
心情不错的张三笑着回道：“哈！不用了，我就这么回去。”
说罢，张三下意识的轻轻碰了碰其右手腕部那个坚硬圆润的物体。
长袖下那似玉镶金的护腕上面有一颗鸽子蛋大的红宝石和十二个米粒大的颜色各异的小宝石，一看就价值不菲，而张三也不会故意露财给自己招惹麻烦。
只是这个耗费了自己大量点数兑换的储物魂导器，如果只是让自己省去拿行李的工夫，那到底是值还是不值呢？
不知道为何，明明当时买得毫不犹豫的张三，现在却开始后悔起来。

张三前两世都是穷人一个，穷了两辈子，自然有守财奴的性子，他巴不得自己能够把这什么怨念点数攒到直接买神器。
不过这时张三又转念一想，这个所谓的系统都是前世的他所没有的，那么自己现在换出来的玩意儿都相当于不要钱的赠品。
这样一想，张三心情就平复多了。
后来张三再坐了一会儿，其他带着大包小包的孩子们终于陆陆续续的赶来，在货车上放好行李后，就上了张三所在的载人马车。
“哼！真的是，慢慢吞吞的！快上车！”
这时一个走路摇摇晃晃的男人一边没好气叫唤着，一边慢慢爬上驾车的位置，由于张三来得早坐在最里面，和这男人挨得很近，他能嗅到这个人身上那一身的酒气。
张三猜测到，这个男人莫不是就那个喝醉酒的车夫？
这个现在还有些醉醺醺的车夫在用颤抖的双手拿好缰绳后，就在口中嘟囔道：
“真的是，居然让我载这些废物回去……”
听到这话，张三原本的好心情瞬间变差了。
不管是车夫或是周边的仆役，哪怕是之前的引路人，都从他来时那客客气气对他们嘘寒问暖的模样，变得冷淡甚至会露出轻蔑的表情，说出讥讽的话语。
趋炎附势，是人的本性。
content_en:
In fact, the system has introduced this paper substitute in detail, but you have to look for it in the "Item Picture Book" in the system panel.
After getting the system prompt, Zhang San went to check and found that the detailed introduction above was:
[Rare props·Stand-in paper man]
[Background: Originally created by Jialan, the founder of Miao voodoo, and later transformed by dozens of generations, it is a stand-in talisman. "The paper man sets himself on fire to ward off disasters for others." 】
[Characteristics: resistance, survival, consumables. 】
[Effects of use: 1. Immediately generate a paper man stand-in; 2. The paper man stand-in can resist damage for the user, and before the paper man is completely destroyed, the enemy's priority attack target will always be on the paper man (this effect can be resisted by mental power); 3. Before the paper man is completely destroyed, the user can increase the movement speed and enter the invisible state (this effect is removed immediately after attacking or being attacked). 】
[Remarks: The paper substitute itself does not have any attack or dodge capabilities, nor does it inherit any special abilities from the user. Its physical strength is the same as the user's. 】
"This is a good life-saving thing, but it can't be used indiscriminately again."
After reading the introduction, Zhang San finally understood how useful these "paper stand-ins" were. Instead of being "paper stand-ins", they were clearly "life-saving paper people." It would not be an exaggeration to say that these three paper stand-ins gave him three extra lives.
But now that he had accidentally wasted one, he suddenly felt heartbroken and quickly put the remaining two paper figures into the "Thirteenth Floor Sun-Shielding Sky" to avoid further mistakes.
"Disperse!"
The paper man transformed into "Zhang San" turned into a burst of white smoke under the stimulation of Zhang San's thoughts, and soon disappeared without a trace.
While Zhang San was marveling at all this, Zhang San glanced at the clock outside and found that there was not much time before his departure, so he was about to go to the scheduled carriage meeting point.
Since he had a storage soul guide, but everyone around him was carrying large and small bags, Zhang San, who was empty-handed, climbed into the carriage proudly and found a seat inside to sit down.
Behind the manned carriage was a longboard truck. The driver of the truck called out: "Hey! Boy, do you have any luggage? Put it here."
Zhang San, who was in a good mood, smiled and replied: "Ha! No need, I'll just go back."
After saying that, Zhang San subconsciously touched the hard and round object on his right wrist.
The jade-like gold-inlaid wristband under the long sleeves has a ruby ​​the size of a pigeon egg and twelve small gems of different colors the size of rice grains. It is worth a lot at first glance, and Zhang San will not deliberately show off his wealth to cause trouble for himself.
It's just that this storage soul guide cost me a lot of points to redeem. If it just saves me the time of picking up my luggage, is it worth it or not?
I don’t know why, but Zhang San, who obviously bought it without hesitation at the time, is starting to regret it now.
Zhang San was a poor man in his first two lives. After being poor for two lifetimes, he naturally had the temperament of a miser. He wished he could save these resentment points to buy artifacts directly.
But then Zhang San thought again, this so-called system was something he didn't have in his previous life, so the gadgets he replaced now were equivalent to free gifts.
Thinking of this, Zhang San felt much calmer.
Later, Zhang San sat for a while, and other children with large and small bags finally arrived one after another. After putting their luggage in the truck, they got on the passenger carriage where Zhang San was.
"Humph! It's true, take your time! Get in the car quickly!"
At this time, a staggering man shouted angrily as he slowly climbed into the driving seat. Since Zhang San arrived early and sat in the back, very close to the man, he could smell the smell of alcohol on this man's body.
Zhang San guessed that this man was the drunk coachman?
The driver, who is still a little drunk now, is holding it with trembling hands.After taking the reins, he muttered in his mouth:
"Really, you actually asked me to take these rubbish back..."
Hearing this, Zhang San's original good mood suddenly deteriorated.
Whether it was the coachman or the surrounding servants, even the previous guide, they all changed from the polite way of greeting them when he arrived, to becoming cold and even showing contempt and uttering sarcastic words.
It is human nature to follow the crowd.
